resources.string: Your profile is kept by your home node. Join a node to have one.
Tap to unlock with your screen lock.
Your account has a passphrase. Changing your profile needs it.
Enter a valid email address, or leave it empty.
This identity hasn\'t joined a node yet.
Scan this with Boson Identity on another phone to join the same node.
Manage your plan on your node\'s web portal.
Remove this identity from this phone
Its keys are deleted, and this phone is signed out of the node. Your account on the node stays.
Its key will be deleted from this phone. Only your backup of the key can bring this identity back. Your account on the node is not deleted.
You haven\'t backed up this identity\'s key. If you remove it, the identity is lost forever: no one, not even the node, can bring it back.
To confirm, type the first 4 characters of its ID: %1$s
Remove this identity from this phone
Its keys will be deleted from this phone
Signing this phone out of the node needs your account passphrase.
This phone couldn\'t be signed out of the node: %1$s Remove the identity from this phone anyway? The node keeps listing this phone until you remove it from another device.
Boson Identity keeps your Boson identity on this phone, under your control, and uses it to look after your account, devices and nodes.
For the operators of %1$s: users, plans, federation and the blacklist. Opens admin mode for 10 minutes.
Back up your key first: until you do, this identity can\'t act with its authority.
